sql: /* Query 3: filter2_agg1_join1 (player, team) */ SELECT player.team, AVG(player.mvp_awards) AS avg_player_mvp_awards FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE player.college = 'Michigan State University' AND player.age <= 62 GROUP BY player.team

mvp_awards.description: number of NBA MVP awards the player has won; use 0 if none (e.g., 2).

team.description: the current NBA team the player belongs to, or the last NBA team the player joined if not currently active (e.g., Los Angeles Lakers).
